training and social influence induce correlated deviations."],"overturn_conditions":["Non-listed cues are unknowable or unmeasurable in the evaluation, making the test infeasible.","The panel's training includes implicit access to non-listed cues, invalidating the 'checklist-only' framing."],"shared_structure":["In residual diagnostics, unmodeled structure in errors reveals a missing predictor; here, unmodeled structure in panel errors reveals a missing checklist cue.","A model can score well by matching a proxy that correlates with the target, yet still show systematic error on the proxy-orthogonal subspace."],"source_memory_refs":["SRC_006","SRC_007"],"transfer_claims":["Test the panel's errors against non-checklist features exactly as one tests regression residuals against omitted variables.","A flat residual structure is evidence of genuine coverage; a structured residual is evidence of compliance-tracking."]},"claim":"The distinguishing evidence within a single evaluation is the covariance of panel errors with checklist-irrelevant, outcome-relevant features: if checklist compliance tracks the right answer but panel members err together whenever a non-listed cue is decisive, the gain is mere compliance, not genuine reliability.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If there are no outcome-relevant cues outside the checklist, the test cannot discriminate, and the question reduces to trivial cases.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If panel members have heterogeneous private cues not on the checklist, the structured-error signature may be diluted even without genuine reliability.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the single expert also fails on non-listed-cue cases, the test no longer separates compliance from expertise.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"If the panel is genuinely more reliable, residual errors should be approximately independent of any outcome-relevant feature the checklist ignores, and should look like uncorrelated noise. If instead the panel's 'success' is compliance-tracking, the panel's errors will cluster systematically on the subset of cases where a non-listed cue is the decisive predictor, yielding a structured error pattern (not noise) with positive correlation across panelists. An error-feature regression on non-listed cues is the discriminating observable: a genuine reliability gain implies zero/near-zero coefficient; compliance-tracking implies a large positive coefficient.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
